name: Monstera Deliciosa
description: Famous for its iconic natural leaf holes. Thrives in bright, indirect sunlight.

name: Snake Plant
description: An incredibly hardy plant that purifies the air and survives in low light.

name: Pothos
description: Fast-growing trailing vine featuring heart-shaped, variegated green leaves.

name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
description: A popular statement plant with large, glossy, violin-shaped structural leaves.

name: Aloe Vera
description: Known for the soothing gel inside its thick, fleshy, serrated green leaves.

name: Spider Plant
description: Produces long, narrow arching leaves with dangling baby plantlets.

name: Peace Lily
description: Features deep green foliage and striking, elegant hooded white blooms.

name: Boston Fern
description: Thrives in high humidity with feather-like, classic sprawling fronds.

name: Lavender
description: An aromatic shrub producing clusters of fragrant, soothing purple flowers.

name: Rosemary
description: A fragrant, needle-like evergreen herb widely utilized in culinary dishes.
